answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across agents. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty grows quadratically, O(k²), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the correlated swarm, while asymmetric depreciation destroys value faster than it can be replenished. A dawn-sized foothold becomes a zenith-level liability, and a lantern-like audit trail preserves attribution.
